class ProtectedRoot { protected x = 1; }
class ProtectedDerived extends ProtectedRoot {
  make() { return new class { get(a: ProtectedRoot) { return a.x; } }; }
}
class PrivateRoot { private x = 1; }
class PrivateDerived extends PrivateRoot {
  make() { return new class { get(a: PrivateRoot) { return a.x; } }; }
}
class NestedDerivedAccess {
  protected value=4;
  make() { return new class extends NestedDerivedAccess { get(a:NestedDerivedAccess) { return a.value; } }; }
}
